name: sftp
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M18 16.5a4.5 4.5 0 0 0-.9-8.9 6 6 0 0 0-11.4 1.6A4 4 0 0 0 6.5 17"/><path d="M12 12v7"/><path d="m9 15 3-3 3 3"/></svg>
description: 项目级 SFTP 同步：配置存项目 .pi/sftp.json（多环境 profile + .pi/sftp.local.json 本机覆盖），先算差异再传，扫描与传输按层/按文件并行且随时可停（面板「停止」或 action=cancel），支持 dry-run 预览与计划复用（预览完直接执行不重扫）、删除保护（进垃圾桶可回滚）、并发流式传输与原子落盘；打开远端命令执行后另有两条快通道（一次 find 完成远端扫描；一批小文件上行打成 tar 流、下行 tar -czf - 一次拉回，失败自动回落）；凭据走 ${env:} / ${secret:} / ${file:} 引用，明文永不进配置。面板里可直接手动上传/下载单个文件或整棵目录（永不动删除策略），也向 AI 注册**一个** action 式 sftp 工具（status/save/secret/test/plan/sync/cancel/ls/read/write/mkdir/mv/rm/search，可选 exec）。
descriptionEn: Project-scoped SFTP sync: config lives in the project's .pi/sftp.json (multi-profile, with .pi/sftp.local.json machine override). Plans a diff before transferring; scanning and transfers run in parallel and can be stopped at any time (the panel's Stop button, or action=cancel); dry-run preview plus plan reuse (running right after a preview skips the rescan), delete protection (moved to a trash folder so it can be rolled back), concurrent streaming transfers and atomic writes; with exec access enabled two extra fast paths kick in (one remote find for the whole scan, and one tar batch per direction for a pile of small files, both falling back automatically); credentials use ${env:} / ${secret:} / ${file:} references so plaintext never lands in the config. The panel can upload or download a single file or a whole folder by hand (never touching the delete policy), and the AI gets one action-style sftp tool (status/save/secret/test/plan/sync/cancel/ls/read/write/mkdir/mv/rm/search, plus optional exec).

descriptionEn: Let the AI drive the Windows desktop: find controls by name via UI Automation (no screenshots) → click / type (CJK via paste) / hotkeys / focus windows. The input library auto-installs on activate and is removed with the plugin.

name: SoL-Pi 状态
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="13 2 3 14 12 14 11 22 21 10 12 10 13 2"/></svg>
description: SoL-Pi 会话节省统计与规划底栏：实时追踪大工具输出打包（Observation Pack）节省的上下文 Token 与在线计划（Plan）进度，借鉴 pi-sol-plan-footer 在底栏显示。
descriptionEn: SoL-Pi session savings and plan status in the footer bar: real-time tracking of context tokens saved by Observation Pack and active Plan progress, inspired by pi-sol-plan-footer.

name: 会话迁移
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 0 1 9-9 9.75 9.75 0 0 1 6.74 2.74L21 8"/><path d="M21 3v5h-5"/><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 0 1-9 9 9.75 9.75 0 0 1-6.74-2.74L3 16"/><path d="M8 16H3v5"/></svg>
description: 扫描 ~/.omp/agent/sessions 与 ~/.pi/agent/sessions 的历史会话，只读预览后一键导入 pi 会话库（issue 286 Phase 1）。
descriptionEn: Scan ~/.omp/agent/sessions and ~/.pi/agent/sessions history, preview read-only, then import into the pi session store (issue 286 Phase 1).

name: 进程管家
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="2" y="2" width="20" height="8" rx="2"/><rect x="2" y="14" width="20" height="8" rx="2"/><line x1="6" y1="6" x2="6.01" y2="6"/><line x1="6" y1="18" x2="6.01" y2="18"/></svg>
description: 用 pm2 统一托管 AI 启动的后台任务：长期服务与调试实例交给 pm2 后有名字、有状态、有日志，顶栏「后台任务」面板与插件面板同一份列表，可看状态/CPU/内存/重启/日志、单独停止或删除；未装 pm2 时一键安装。不拦截 AI 的命令，管不管由模型和用户自行决定。
descriptionEn: Supervise AI-started background tasks with pm2: long-running services and debug instances get a name, a status and logs, so the host background-tasks panel and the plugin panel show one shared list with status/CPU/memory/restarts/logs plus per-app stop or delete; one-click pm2 install when missing. It never intercepts AI commands — whether a process goes through pm2 is up to the model and the user.

name: 动态壁纸
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect width="18" height="18" x="3" y="3" rx="2" ry="2"/><circle cx="9" cy="9" r="2"/><path d="m21 15-3.086-3.086a2 2 0 0 0-2.828 0L6 21"/></svg>
description: 动态壁纸：自动扫描本机 Wallpaper Engine 创意工坊壁纸，支持视频壁纸播放、液态毛玻璃磨砂效果与壁纸库抽屉。
descriptionEn: Wallpaper Engine: scans Steam Workshop, supports video wallpapers, liquid frosted glass effects and a wallpaper library drawer.

name: 响应速度
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="13 2 3 14 12 14 11 22 21 10 12 10 13 2"/></svg>
description: AI 响应速度监控：实时统计并显示当前回答的 AI 首字响应耗时（TTFT，发送请求到首个响应的时间）以及底部状态栏的平均响应速度，支持点击底栏查看统计明细与历史趋势。
descriptionEn: AI response speed monitoring: real-time tracking of Time to First Token (TTFT) latency for the current response and the average speed in the bottom status bar, with details and history dialog.

name: browser-use
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M12 2a14.5 14.5 0 0 0 0 20 14.5 14.5 0 0 0 0-20"/><path d="M2 12h20"/></svg>
description: 常驻 Chrome 自动化：自动拉起或接管常驻浏览器窗口，支持多标签页切换、精简交互元素快照（极省 Token）、智能点击输入、反爬穿透与状态跨任务持久。
descriptionEn: Persistent Chrome automation: launches or attaches to a persistent Chrome instance, supports tab management, human-visible element snapshots, smart clicks and inputs, and anti-bot resilience across tasks.

name: 语音合成 (TTS)
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="11 5 6 9 2 9 2 15 6 15 11 19 11 5"/><path d="M19.07 4.93a10 10 0 0 1 0 14.14M15.54 8.46a5 5 0 0 1 0 7.07"/></svg>
description: 将豆包和 DeepSeek 语音及音色注册到系统统一 TTS 中心，供网页播报、QQ 自动回复和其他工具共用。支持浏览器扩展同步凭据、引擎音色查询与音频文件生成。
descriptionEn: Registers Doubao and DeepSeek engines and voices in the shared TTS center for web playback, QQ replies, and other tools. Includes credential synchronization, engine/voice discovery, and audio-file generation.

name: 网络隧道
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"/><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"/></svg>
description: 反向隧道：主人设备 CLI 主动连入（零公网暴露，穿 NAT），pi 经本机 SOCKS5 以主人所在网络为出口做巡检与访问（DNS 在主人侧解析）。面板展示隧道在线状态/连接数/令牌管理；注册 tunnel_fetch 工具供 AI 直接探测主人网络。
descriptionEn: Reverse tunnel: the owner's device dials in (no public exposure, NAT-friendly); pi reaches the owner's network via local SOCKS5 with DNS resolved owner-side. Panel shows tunnel status/connections/token; tunnel_fetch tool for AI probes.

name: 拍板
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M22 5H2v11h20z"/><path d="M12 16v4"/><path d="M8 20h8"/><path d="M7 9l3 3 5-5"/></svg>
description: 定时任务拍板中心：待拍板项集中列表，点击跳转对应会话完成拍板；通用 CLI 供任意定时任务登记；顶栏拍板 tab 红点显示待拍板数。
descriptionEn: Approval gate: centralized pending-decision list from scheduled tasks; click an item to jump into its conversation; red-dot badge on the tab shows pending count. A generic CLI lets any cron job register items.

name: Live2D 看板娘
description: 页面悬浮 Live2D 桌面看板娘宠物：支持 Cubism 2/3/4 模型渲染、鼠标视线跟随、触摸点击反应、气泡对话台词、伴随 AI 思考/回复情绪联动与 AI 动作表情操控工具。
descriptionEn: Interactive Live2D companion on your screen: Cubism 2/3/4 models, mouse eye-tracking, tap reactions, speech bubbles, AI emotion reactivity, and agent tools.

name: office
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M14.5 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V7.5L14.5 2z"/><polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/><line x1="16" y1="13" x2="8" y2="13"/><line x1="16" y1="17" x2="8" y2="17"/><line x1="10" y1="9" x2="8" y2="9"/></svg>
description: 基于 Univer 引擎的高保真 Office 原生画布预览与编辑：接管工作区 .pptx / .docx / .xlsx 真实渲染，支持 1:1 排版放映与 AI 结构化表格修改写回。
descriptionEn: Office Canvas preview and editing powered by Univer, with structured AI operations and conflict-checked disk export.

name: bili-scroll
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="2" y="7" width="20" height="15" rx="3"/><polyline points="17 2 12 7 7 2"/><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="8" y2="12.01"/><line x1="16" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12.01"/></svg>
description: 每天替你刷一轮 B 站：通读原文字幕深度排雷、三档位精选、默认私信投递、支持私信双向对话与分享看片、视频卡片墙与自动收藏。
descriptionEn: Autonomous Bilibili duty agent: reads raw subtitles to filter fluff, delivers curated video digests directly to private DMs, supports bidirectional DM chat, video card wall, and auto-favorite.

name: 额度看板
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 3v18h18"/><rect x="7" y="7" width="3" height="9" rx="1"/><rect x="13" y="11" width="3" height="5" rx="1"/></svg>
description: 底栏只显示当前模型对应那家的额度，点它，宿主弹出跟随位置的小卡片：自动读取本机已登录的 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode（Go 订阅剩余额度）登录态，DeepSeek 填一次 Key 即可；卡片里是剩余百分比、重置倒计时与账户余额，刷新按钮外圈就是自动刷新进度、旁边实时显示数据有多旧，点刷新底栏与卡片同一帧更新，AI 也能用工具直接查。只查当前供应商，别家订阅不出网、不打扰。凭据只在本机读取，不外传、不写盘。
descriptionEn: The bottom bar shows only the quota of the provider behind your current model; click it and the host pops a small card right next to it: local Antigravity, Claude Code and Codex logins are read automatically (DeepSeek needs one API key), with remaining percentage, reset countdowns and balance — the refresh button doubles as an auto-refresh progress ring, the data's age is shown live, and one click updates the bar and the card in the same frame. The AI can query it too. Only that provider is queried; other subscriptions are left alone. Credentials stay on this machine; nothing is uploaded or persisted.
